implementationNotes: Java issues one bounded call per calendar date with suspend_type=S.
A returned S row normalizes to is_suspended=1 for that date; the flag does not assert full-day suspension.
Java uses a finite 5-calendar-day job window and 2-day revision overlap; current configured endpoint rate still needs root integration review.
